integrity: The package distinguishes the published Proposition 7.1 from the new closure-equality consequence. The finite script verifies only the incidence witness; the algebraicity step is cited rather than simulated.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the specific diagonal triple arising from a generating quadrangle; no claim is made for every 3-set.
No minimality claim for three parameters is made.
The exact definable closure of the diagonal triple is not classified.
title: Three diagonal points algebraically generate an elementary free projective plane
